decisions.writer_experiments: Both deferred-writer candidates are rejected and their code is removed from the selected tree. Runtime yield reduced unary/pipeline positive writes to C++ parity in short captures, but added an empty event-loop poll per output turn, 23.90–25.25% unary instructions, and 18.06% unary mean latency. Ordinary wake removed the empty polls and lost the syscall improvement, while still increasing unary instructions 14.40–15.96%, unary mean latency 11.67%, callback mean latency 26.61%, and four-service mean latency 17.99%. The experiments preserve error/flush/shutdown correctness but do not improve the overall performance target. The remaining architectural requirement is coordinated application/protocol/output scheduling with physical receipt ownership; deferring a second task alone is insufficient.
